description: This file provides a client API for interacting with a backend server using fetch. It includes functions for GET, POST, PUT requests, health checks, and mock data fallbacks, with environment-based configuration.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the normalized base URL for the API without trailing slash.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the backend API at the specified path.

methods.name: apiPost
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the backend API at the specified path with a JSON body.

methods.name: apiPut
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the backend API at the specified path with a JSON body.

methods.name: getAuthHeader
methods.description: Returns an authorization header with a Bearer token if available in local storage.

methods.name: apiHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check request to the backend API.
